Alexandr Wang - Wikipedia

Alexandr Wang
Alexandr Wang
(
Chinese
:
汪滔
;
pinyin
:
Wāng Tāo
;
[
2
]
born January 1997) is an American entrepreneur. He has been the chief AI officer of
Meta Platforms
since 2025 and leads its
Superintelligence Labs
.
[
3
]
He is the co-founder and former CEO of
Scale AI
, an artificial intelligence company that provides
data labeling
and
large language model
evaluation services to develop AI applications.
[
4
]
[
5
]
In 2021, Wang became the world's youngest "self-made billionaire" at age 24.
[
6
]
[
7
]
[
8
]
Forbes
estimated his net worth at $3.6 billion
as of April
2025
[
update
]
.
[
9
]
Early life and education
Alexandr Wang was born in
Los Alamos, New Mexico
in January 1997 to Chinese immigrants who worked as physicists at the
Los Alamos National Laboratory
in New Mexico.
[
1
]
[
10
]
Wang grew passionate about math and computer programming at a young age. He qualified for the
Math Olympiad Program
in 2013, the
US Physics Team
in 2014, and was a USACO finalist in 2012 and 2013.
[
11
]
He studied at
Los Alamos High School
, before moving to Silicon Valley to become a
software engineer
at
Addepar
, a wealth management company.
[
12
]
[
13
]
During his teens, Wang worked for
Quora
as a software programmer.
[
14
]
He briefly attended the
Massachusetts Institute of Technology
(MIT) and had an internship at the high-frequency trading firm
Hudson River Trading
, but dropped out of MIT to co-found Scale AI in 2016.
[
15
]
[
16
]
Career
In 2016, Wang and
Lucy Guo
co-founded Scale AI, an artificial intelligence company that provides
data labeling
and
model
evaluation services to develop AI applications. Former
Amazon
executive Jeff Wilke served as an advisor to Wang.
[
17
]
In 2021, the company's valuation hit $7.3
billion, briefly giving Wang a $1
billion net worth, as he owned 15% of the company.
[
5
]
[
18
]
Scale AI has received defense contracts from the
United States Armed Forces
, and has been tapped by the
Pentagon
's
Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office
to
test and evaluate
the safety and reliability of
large language models
for military planning and decision-making.
[
19
]
[
20
]
[
21
]
Wang joined the board of
Expedia Group
in 2023.
[
22
]
In July 2023, Wang testified before a
House Armed Services subcommittee
hearing, speaking on the challenges and potential solutions that the U.S. government faced in adopting AI.
[
23
]
Wang introduced a hiring approach he called “merit, excellence, and intelligence” (MEI) in June 2024, explicitly framing it in opposition to corporate diversity, equity, and inclusion (
DEI
) programs. The announcement drew praise from figures including
Elon Musk
and
Coinbase
CEO
Brian Armstrong
, while DEI researchers said it mischaracterized how diversity initiatives actually functioned.
[
24
]
[
25
]
In January 2025, Wang was among a group of tech-based founders and chief executive officers at the
second inauguration of Donald Trump
.
[
26
]
He also wrote a letter directly to President Trump, stating that “America must win the AI war.”
[
27
]
Later in the month, Wang spoke at the
World Economic Forum
, highlighting the AI race between the United States and China, specifically surrounding the capabilities of
DeepSeek
.
[
28
]
In February 2025, Wang met with multiple world leaders, including UK Prime Minister
Keir Starmer
, Indian Prime Minister
Narendra Modi
, French President
Emmanuel Macron
,
[
29
]
and
United States House of Representatives
speaker
Mike Johnson
, who also oversees the House Bipartisan Task Force on Artificial Intelligence,
[
30
]
speaking to them about global cooperation surrounding AI.
[
29
]
In June 2025,
Meta Platforms
purchased 49% of Scale AI and Wang moved to work for Meta. He stepped down as CEO of Scale but remained on the board of Scale AI.
[
31
]
Meta announced that it will invest $14.3 billion in Scale AI, which will be overseen by
Meta Superintelligence Labs
.
[
32
]
[
33
]
Personal life
During the height of the
COVID-19 pandemic
, Wang was roommates with his friend
Sam Altman
, the chief executive officer of
OpenAI
.
[
26
]
Recognition
In 2018, Wang was named to
Forbes
'
s
30 Under 30
list in the Enterprise Technology category.
[
34
]
He was named to the same list in 2021.
[
35
]
He was also named to the
Time
100 Next
, which recognizes emerging leaders who are shaping the future of their fields, and to the
Time
100 AI list.
[
7
]
